results.problem: Matrix-vector product and matrix multiplication with adjacency matrix
results.bound: $O_{\mathcal{C}}(n^2)$ preprocessing, $O_{\mathcal{C}}(n)$ per vector; $O_{\mathcal{C}}(n^2)$ for $n\times n$ matrix
results.quote: For every graph class C of linear neighborhood complexity, there is an O_C(n^2)-time algorithm that, given any adjacency matrix M of an n-vertex graph of C, yields a data structure that computes the matrix-vector product MX in time O_C(n) for any n-vector X. In particular, the product MN can be computed in O_C(n^2) time for any n×n matrix N.

results.quote: For every graph class C of linear neighborhood complexity, Triangle Detection can be solved in expected time O_C(n+m) on n-vertex m-edge graphs of C.
